name: TableInstruct
description: TableInstruct is a dataset constructed for instruction tuning and evaluating large language models on a variety of realistic table-based tasks. It supports the development of open-source generalist models for tables, enhancing model generalizability across in-domain and out-of-domain table tasks.
typical_sota_score: varies by subtask; roughly 80–95% for top LLMs on common table understanding subtasks
reputation: A relatively new but useful table-focused benchmark that has been cited for broadening evaluation beyond narrow table QA and for supporting generalist table instruction tuning.
notes: Supports both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluation; first open-source generalist model for tables (TableLlama) trained on this dataset.
